pages.text: These mods add buildings to the Overworld and beyond. They need no setup: walk, ride or fly and you will find them. Most have chests that follow $(l:exploration/lootr)Lootr$(/l)'s per-player loot rules.
$(thing)Towns and Towers$() adds many new village styles, pillager outposts, a wandering trader camp and ships, as variants for different biomes.
$(thing)Dungeons and Taverns$() adds hamlets, taverns for every wood, wells, crypts, shrines, firewatch towers and Nether and End builds: Nether keeps and ports, End castles, ships and lighthouses.

$(thing)When Dungeons Arise$() adds big roguelike builds: coliseum, aviary, bandit towers, foundry, illager forts, monasteries, shiraz palace, plague asylum, typhon, thornborn towers and a mechanical nest. Several have bosses.

$(thing)YUNG's$() series reworks vanilla structures: Better Dungeons, Mineshafts, Strongholds, Desert Temples, Jungle Temples, Witch Huts and Ocean Monuments. Same places, much better builds and loot.

pages.title: Dungeon Loot
pages.text: The chests in these builds are the reason to visit. Lootr makes them per-player.
